comment: Advisories that npm audit --omit dev may report without failing the build. Every entry needs an expiry so an unfixable advisory cannot silently become permanent; see docs/security.md, 'Dependency pinning and supply chain'.

exceptions.reason: extract-zip has no patched release; it reaches us only through prime-agent's harness download path, which unpacks release archives fetched over HTTPS from the pinned publisher. Re-check for a fixed version, or vendor a patched tarball, before the expiry.
